All of them were involved. That’s how the owner affords expensive SUVs

SCAM ALERT!
I was traveling on 29th May with my daughter. I stopped here for refueling around 10.30pm at night and asked them for 3000 rupees petrol. I have experienced that people on petrol pump tend to scam ladies especially but here it was at every step.
1. I got out of my car because one person of their staff started insisting on checking water levels and asked to open my bonnet
2. He started filling water and hence I got distracted and did not check my petrol levels (I had checked zero but could not check whether they filled it as much as I had paid for)
3. Then he claimed that my coolant was very low and my AC will stop working if I don't get it filled (I knew he was scamming me because I got my car AC servicing done a month back) so I just said, 'please don't scam me just because I'm a lady. It's late at night, this is not a good practice'
4. When I went for an air check, of course the guy told me I had a puncture in one tyre, I did not trust him and just drove from there (I later got it checked from my trusted person and there is no puncture in any tyre)
5. I also noticed that fuel level was less, when I told them, they blamed that petrol had become more expensive hence I must have "felt" that way. I waited till today to fuel my car just to confirm and realised that I was right, they did shortchange the fuel for me!!

This was wrong on so many levels!
I was a lady travelling at night with my daughter and they tried to scam me at every step possible!

If you are going to come here for fuel, please please remember, do not take your eyes off of your fuel level at any point.
If they are saying let me check this and that, ask them to do it once fuel is completely filled.
Do not fall for their scams and see your trusted mechanic instead.

Whoever is the owner/manager, please teach your staff that instead of scamming lady drivers, that too traveling alone at night (highly highly unethical) they should instead show more courteous and helpful attitude towards them. Your money making attitude by scamming people will not go a long way.
